independentlyProven.title: Reconnect during preload can miss the fresh-session full inventory clear

evidence.claim: Preload performs the fresh-session clear only over players online when the timed preload callback executes.
Preloading reconnect restores gameplay state/position but does not replay the full inventory clear.
Later loadout application defaults to managed-item cleanup rather than a full-slot clear.

independentlyProven.title: Active-session reconnect recovery can overwrite a pending respawn lifecycle

evidence.claim: CombatTracker owns pending respawn and restores reconnecting players to spectator/countdown state.
GameManager independently handles the same initialSpawn and, after five ticks, restores survival/loadout/position for an active session without consulting pending respawn ownership.

independentlyProven.title: Six enabled arenas are admission-limited to two concurrent arena leases

evidence.claim: Six arenas are explicitly enabled and independently offset.
TickingAreaManager hard-limits concurrent held/in-flight arena leases to MAX_CONCURRENT_ARENAS = 2 and queues later requests.

auditObligations.question: Force-start/force-end/reset/skip-level handlers do not visibly perform an admin check at the handler boundary. Determine whether an ordinary player has any selected-artifact path that can emit these script events before classifying a gameplay defect.

evidence.claim: Administrative gameplay script-event handlers are registered and execute without a local PermissionService check.
